patterns.note: Alternating full-bleed editorial photography sections with structured product grids, creating a magazine-like flow.
Consistent use of clean, uppercase sans-serif typography for navigation, headings, and product labels, reinforcing a sophisticated brand identity.
A minimalist color palette dominated by black, white, and light grey, allowing product photography to introduce vibrant accents.
The initial hero image features a subtle parallax scroll, where the background image moves slower than the page, creating a sense of depth as the user scrolls down.
The primary navigation bar remains sticky at the top of the viewport, ensuring brand visibility and constant access to menu items.
Large, impactful full-bleed photography sections serve as visual breaks and thematic introductions between product display areas.

technique_notes: The hero section and subsequent large image sections employ a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the background image translates vertically at a slower rate than the page scroll, enhancing visual depth.
The global navigation bar is implemented as a sticky element, fixing it to the top of the viewport after initial scroll, ensuring persistent access to site navigation and brand identity.
Product displays are organized into responsive grids, often 2x2 or 4-column, with consistent padding and hover effects for individual items.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clean sans-serif hierarchy with prominent, often uppercase, headings and labels (~2-3x body text) balanced by legible body text, maintaining a sophisticated and airy feel.
design_tokens.spacing: balanced to airy, with generous padding around major sections and a more structured, consistent spacing within product grids.

standout: The site's design stands out by seamlessly blending high-fashion editorial photography with a clean e-commerce interface. It creates an immersive brand experience that feels more like browsing a luxury magazine than a typical online store, using large, impactful imagery as primary section dividers.
